description: A pediatric antibiotic suspension prepared from capsules when commercial suspension is unavailable or inappropriate strength is needed
clinicalUse: Bacterial infections in pediatric patients requiring customized dosing

prescriptionDetails.examplePrescription: Amoxicillin 50 mg/mL oral suspension, Make 100 mL, Sig: Take 5 mL twice daily for 10 days

formulation.beyondUseDate: 14 days from preparation when stored under refrigeration (2-8°C)

dosageCalculations.step: Calculate total amount of amoxicillin needed

dosageCalculations.calculation: 1:1 mixture of Ora-Plus and Ora-Sweet SF
dosageCalculations.result: 50 mL Ora-Plus + 50 mL Ora-Sweet SF = 100 mL total

steps.description: Count and verify 10 amoxicillin 500 mg capsules
Open capsules and empty contents into mortar
Add approximately 10 mL of Ora-Plus to the powder
Triturate the powder with Ora-Plus to form a smooth paste
steps.notes: Ensure no lumps remain; paste should be smooth and uniform

steps.description: Add Ora-Plus in portions (about 10-15 mL at a time) while mixing
steps.notes: Continue until all Ora-Plus is incorporated (total 50 mL)
Use spatula to ensure complete transfer

steps.description: Rinse mortar and pestle with Ora-Sweet SF and add to cylinder
steps.notes: Multiple rinses may be needed to ensure complete transfer

steps.description: Add Ora-Sweet SF to bring volume to 100 mL mark
steps.notes: Ensure meniscus is at 100 mL mark at eye level

steps.description: Mix thoroughly by inverting graduated cylinder multiple times

steps.notes: Use funnel if needed to prevent spillage

visualInspection.notes: Should have uniform appearance when shaken; no large clumps or aggregates

labeling.directions: Take 5 mL by mouth twice daily for 10 days
warnings: Keep out of reach of children
Complete full course even if feeling better

safety.allergyConsiderations: Contains amoxicillin (penicillin). Verify no penicillin allergy.

counselingPoints: Shake bottle well before each use
Store in refrigerator; do not freeze
Use provided oral syringe for accurate measurement
Complete entire course even if symptoms improve
May take with or without food
Contact prescriber if rash, diarrhea, or other adverse effects occur
Discard any unused medication after 14 days

stability.notes: Commercial amoxicillin suspensions typically stable 14 days refrigerated after reconstitution

references: Marriott JF. Pharmaceutical Compounding and Dispensing. 2nd ed. Chapter 5: Suspensions
Trissel LA. Trissel's Stability of Compounded Formulations. 6th ed.
Allen LV. The Art, Science, and Technology of Pharmaceutical Compounding. 5th ed.

notes.alternativeVehicles: Can also use 1:1 mixture of Simple Syrup NF and methylcellulose 1% gel, or commercially available suspension vehicles
notes.flavoringOptions: Bubble gum or cherry flavor can be added if desired (0.1-0.2 mL per 100 mL)
notes.patientPopulation: Commonly prepared for pediatric patients, but can be used for any patient requiring liquid dosage form
